description: Decode a US 17-character VIN and return the vehicle's year, make, model, trim, engine and standard safety features, plus all NHTSA safety recalls for that make/model/year, an owner-complaint summary and NHTSA crash-test star ratings. Use when the user shares a VIN or asks about a specific car they own or plan to buy. Recalls are matched by make/model/year, not per VIN repair status.
name: check_vehicle_by_vin
title: Check a vehicle by VIN
